A lot of this board reads more autumnal to me and I think this is due to the colours. I've seen a lot more pastels than I feel like this board shows and a fair amount of 'washed'/faded not quite bright colours.

I'm not in London but from our few hot days last week I noticed the common threads of denim shorts (which are always a summer staple here), wide leg trousers with block colour or stripes and wide leg or flowy jumpsuits. Most people were wearing them with just white t-shirts or strappy vest tops. All of this being said London is London and you can dress however and no one would actually blink an eye.

Summer in Britain can be pretty changeable so it is wise to have something like a thin jacket or jumper for evenings plus a waterproof jacket for days that may not be so good. However, I rarely see people wearing tights in the summer even in the evenings, apart from wide fishnets which seem to be having a moment as a trend.
